Does Bozo Patel know he is subject to deposition, answering questions, under oath, asked by real lawyers? 

Bring popcorn.  nytimes.com/2026/04/20/us/po…

Highlighting independents:
46% “worry a great deal” about climate change
46% think climate effects are “underestimated”
47% expect it to “threaten their way of life”

(Note near-zero D support vs. Trump denial onslaught. “Climate hushers,” be damned!)
news.gallup.com/poll/708050/…

Trump: “Nobody’s laughing!”

World: “If we’re not laughing it’s because we’re horrified and disgusted.”
thedailybeast.com/fragile-do…
Sadly, most Democrats slept through the capture.
A captured Court is delivering the goods for the billionaires who captured it.
Legislation, regulation and litigation about climate, all a sacrifice to protect fossil fuel’s $700 billion pollute-for-free business model.
(Of course the Court blocked rules that would have disclosed the coordination among fossil-fuel front group “amici” flotillas.)
Of course fossil-fuel-funded flotillas of phony front groups will be there to instruct the Court, where they have a 100% success rate.
Of course next is the Court attacking climate litigation, finishing the free-to-pollute trifecta for the billionaire polluters who put them there.
(Of course the “major questions” notion was cooked up in fossil-fuel-funded doctrine factories, purpose-built by and for polluters.)
Of course the Clean Power Plan and “major questions” cases signaled the end of climate regulation as the Court intruded to blockade.
Of course Citizens United signaled the end of climate legislation, as unlimited fossil fuel dark money was brought to bear on Congress.
Of course Roberts and Alito, who also delivered Citizens United and dark money, were in the thick of it.

Of course the roots of the “shadow docket” are in service to the fossil fuel billionaires who captured the Court. 🧵
nytimes.com/2026/04/18/us/po…

Pity that all he can do is read it, and not take it in.
politico.com/news/2026/04/17…

Not enough to pollute for free; fossil fuel gets Republicans AGs to provide taxpayer-funded free legal service. 

Ghoulish levels of greed.
nytimes.com/2026/04/16/clima…

When you’re on both sides, you can dictate the result. 

This is the DOJ “ice cream window” that pays off MAGA lawsuits, on conflict-of-interest steroids.
washingtonpost.com/national-…

Trump/Russia rears its ugly head again.
